name: Sweeping Breath Weapon (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Breath Weapon

Benefit(s): Three times per day as a free action you may use your breath weapon in a semi circle with a radius equal to the length of its standard breath weapon attack.

When using your breath weapon in this manner you deal half normal damage.
